terms.definition: An organism that makes its own food by photosynthesis; it starts a food chain.
terms.examiner: Usually a green plant or alga.

terms.definition: In a stable community, prey numbers rise, then predator numbers rise, prey fall, then predators fall; the predator peak lags behind.
terms.examiner: Explain each change in terms of food supply.

terms.definition: A square frame used to sample the number of organisms in an area.
terms.examiner: Estimate the population: mean per quadrat × total area ÷ quadrat area.

terms.definition: A line along which quadrats are placed to see how organisms change across an area.
terms.examiner: Used with a changing abiotic factor such as light.

terms.definition: Carbon is taken in by photosynthesis and returned to the air by respiration of plants, animals and decomposers, and by combustion.
terms.examiner: Decomposers return carbon to the atmosphere and mineral ions to the soil.

terms.definition: The breakdown of dead material by microorganisms.
terms.examiner: Separate Biology: rate depends on temperature, water and oxygen.

terms.definition: Rotted organic matter used as a natural fertiliser.
terms.examiner: Separate Biology. Biogas generators use anaerobic decay to make methane.
